mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen for four consecutive weekly means, from -11.6 to -22.9, and this negative momentum will persist because consumers anchor on recent discretionary-spending reductions; therefore the next 28-day mean will be lower than the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: The next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC equals or exceeds -17.6, the mean of the last four weekly observations (-11.6, -17.0, -18.9, -22.9).

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES rebounded from -59.0 to -32.0 over two consecutive weekly means, signaling a return of commuting and office populations; this raises weekday footfall and drives RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by at least 10 points over two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next 28-day mean is lower than its last 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES rising at least 10 points over two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility is above +10 and TRANSIT is below -50, residents are staying home and avoiding transit-linked commercial districts; this interaction suppresses RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +10 and TRANSIT remains below -50.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM falling from 6.6 to 1.9 signals the end of pantry-loading and essential-only shopping; as this essential spending normalizes, discretionary retail traffic recovers, lifting RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below +2.0 after being above +4.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is lower over the next 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM crosses below +2.0 from above +4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime with TRANSIT still below -50, transit-dependent consumers cannot reach retail centers; therefore RETAIL_REC remains depressed over two weeks even if WORKPLACES improves.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while TRANSIT remains below -50 and WORKPLACES is above -40.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS dropped from +3.4 to -8.9 in the latest weekly mean, indicating a seasonal shift from outdoor leisure to indoor activity; this substitution raises RETAIL_REC over one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 0.0 after a positive weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the next 7 days after PARKS crosses from positive to below 0.0.

mechanism_narrative: The divergence of rising WORKPLACES (-45.0 to -32.0) and stalled TRANSIT (-56.4 to -55.9) indicates a car-based commute recovery; this supports auto-oriented retail and raises RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is lower over the next 14 days when WORKPLACES is above -35 while TRANSIT is below -50.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent TRANSIT below -55 and RESIDENTIAL above +12 define a restrictive-mobility regime that suppresses nonessential retail trips; RETAIL_REC continues lower over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next 28-day mean is higher than its last 28-day mean while TRANSIT is below -55 and RESIDENTIAL is above +12.
